title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: bring your own detections as custom indicators
summary: Hold: the policy configuration path skips choices that determine the wizard route, and the permissions statement excludes administrators Microsoft explicitly authorises. The briefing also incorrectly implies that Insider Risk Management cannot already read Dropbox activity through built-in indicators; its roadmap facts and most preview details are supported.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to accept customers' own activity indicators from homegrown systems, SIEM/UEBA and line-of-business applications for existing Insider Risk Management playbooks.
claims.quote: Allow customers to bring their own user activity indicators from homegrown, SIEM/UEBA platforms, or other line-of-business applications, and leverage them in existing Insider Risk Management playbooks.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Learn instructs administrators to set custom thresholds rather than default thresholds after selecting a custom trigger or indicator.
